Class Article

java.lang.Object
org.example.Article
public class Article extends Object
Represents an item with a unique identifier, a priority level, and a list of operations to be performed on it. This class provides methods to manage and navigate through the operations associated with the item.

The priority of the item can be one of three levels: LOW, NORMAL, or HIGH, defined by the Article.Priority enum. The operations associated with the item are stored in a list and can be accessed sequentially.

  • Method Details

    • fromCSV

      public static Article fromCSV(String csvLine)
      Factory method to create an Item instance from a CSV line. The CSV line should have the following format: idItem;priority;operation1;operation2;...

      If the CSV line does not contain at least three fields, or if the priority is invalid, an IllegalArgumentException will be thrown.

      Parameters:
      csvLine - a string representing a line from a CSV file
      Returns:
      a new Item object created from the CSV data
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the CSV line format is invalid or if the priority is invalid
